Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental factual error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying Robert Menzies as the "founder of Australia's Liberal Party" in the context of his 1939 appointment. While Menzies did become PM in 1939 due to Lyons' death, he was the leader of the *United Australia Party (UAP)* at that time. The Liberal Party of Australia was not founded until 1944. The Planner's initial understanding conflated Menzies' later role (founder of the Liberal Party) with his earlier role (PM of the UAP), leading to a confused search strategy that tried to link the 1939 event to a party that didn't exist yet, and subsequently generated a contradictory narrative about the 1949 election being the cause of his *first* premiership.
